entries.en: to stop; to halt; to detain; to hold back.
to stop or block with the hands; to bar the way.
to stay; to remain; to linger.

entries.notes: R 栏 lēū 与「候」对音不合，依 H/L 的等候义定夺。

entries.zh: 积攒；聚拢；把东西归到一起。
entries.en: to gather; to accumulate; to pile up (marginal note: Juntar los, 'to join them').
entries.notes: L 栏语句残损（con ar, iqueca ha tiempo），依 H「積」、M 音及边注 Juntar los 定夺。

entries.en: to pause to consider; to dwell on a matter.
entries.notes: L 栏「acechador」（窥伺者）语义突兀，H「闕」与注音可合而难确证。
四栏几近全缺，仅存一点画痕迹，无从定夺。
H 栏作「驟」，疑为「駐」之形讹，与 L「Detente」及音读相合。

entries.en: to pull and hold fast; to hold back.
entries.notes: 「蒂」当作「帶」（R tāy 可证），「牽帶」即牵引、拉住，与「Detente」对应稍曲。

entries.en: to wait a moment; to hold on.
to seize with the hands; to come to grips.
entries.notes: 「欽」疑为「擒」之讹（R kiēn 相合），与 L「ir a las manos」（交手）相应。

entries.en: to stop; to cease; to halt.
to block; to stop someone; to hold back.

entries.zh: 扯住衣裳把人拦住；拉住衣服不放。
entries.en: to hold someone by the garment; to clutch at the clothes.
entries.notes: H「監」与「拉住衣襟」义不合，依 L「del vestido」及音读定夺。

entries.en: to entangle; to hinder; to hold back.

entries.zh: 存疑；把疑问搁下不作断定。
entries.en: to leave a doubt unresolved; to suspend judgment.
to clamp; to seize; to arrest.
